questions.subtopic: Magnetic Field due to a Solenoid
questions._flag: CBSE key is (D) radius of the coil, kept. Re-derivation agrees that the field inside a long solenoid (B = μ0 n I) does not depend on the radius, but it also does not depend on the DIRECTION of the current, which only reverses the field: (B) is equally defensible for a question about the field's 'strength'. The paper expects one answer; a human may want to note both.

questions._flag: Transcribed as printed: (i) asks what happens when a ray falls normally on one face of a 'rectangular glass prism'. The marking scheme accepts EITHER a rectangular slab at normal incidence OR a triangular prism diagram, so CBSE itself read the wording as ambiguous (slab vs prism).

(ii) An object is placed at a distance of 30 cm from the optical centre of a concave lens of focal length 20 cm. Use Lens formula to determine the position of the image formed in this case.

State the type of the image formed by the mirror and mention the change in the image formed, if any, that he observes when the candle flame is gradually moved away from the pole of the mirror.
